predictions.why: In this mechanism the terse plain register is derailed by tail tokens sampled after its opening, and most of that damage happens before the first answer marker, so stopping at the first marker only saves the part that comes after it (invented follow-up problems and overwritten answer lines). That adds roughly 15-35 problems to the plain T 1.0 base rate of 224, partly cancelled by self-opened deliberative answers that would otherwise have revised a wrong early box.
